REJECT: the extractions preserve behaviour, but by my count they only remove about 13 points from the original 29, which leaves `ChangeFilters` at about 16, still over the threshold of 15.

I couldn't run the analyzer here, so this rests on a manual Sonar-style count. The removed pieces are the first `foreach`/`if` (about 3) and the `while`/`foreach`/`if`/`&&` dependency walk (about 10). The `if (!reported.Add) continue;` to `if (reported.Add)` rewrite saves nothing, since it keeps the same nesting.
